note: Read by tools/possession_deliver.py. 'steps' is the order of technical fall-backs: a lower step is used only when the step above ends with an error (exception or non-zero exit code) or writes a file that fails the organisers' format rules. A step is never chosen by looking at an output. With clock readings each broadcast step is tried with the clock anchor first, then without it. 'smart_tagging': true marks a step that reads the Smart Tagging file of the bundle; the tool then reports whether that file is present. The first step is the second with one addition: players the tactical tracking has lost are added from the broadcast tracking when the accuracy gate is open (possession-v216-plan.json). The second step pools the v2 models with a second model family (possession-v215-plan.json); every lower step is the v2 models alone. No step uses the kick-off frame published in FAQ.md: the organisers' answer of 12 Nov 2026 did not allow that constant explicitly. possession-v2.11, which uses it, stays in the repository, frozen and unused.
